simple.summary: אַסְנָה (ʼAçnâh) means Asnah , one of the Nethinim First listed occurrence: Ezra 2 50.

definitions.full: H619. Asnah אַסְנָה proper name, masculine (Aramaic אֲסָנָא thorn-bush ?) head of a family of Nethinim Ezra 2:50 (omitted by Neh 7:52 ).
